name: PDF Tools
description: Merge, split, reorder, rotate and delete PDF pages, and turn images into a PDF
help: Organize: add one or more PDFs (or drop them on the window). Every page appears as a thumbnail; drag pages to reorder them, even between files, and rotate, duplicate or delete the selected pages. Export saves a new PDF and never changes the originals.
Click to select a page, ⌘/Ctrl-click to add pages, and Shift-click to select a range. Selected pages move together when you drag them.
Split: cut one PDF into several files by page ranges such as 1-3, 5, 8- (8- means to the last page), every N pages, or one file per page.
Images to PDF: one image per page. JPEG photos are embedded as they are, without being compressed again; other formats are stored losslessly and keep transparency.
Password-protected PDFs ask for the password when opened; exported files are saved without the password.
Bookmarks, forms and links to removed pages are not carried over to the new file.
